item.title: TADA: Fast, Reliable Speech Generation Through Text-Acoustic Synchronization
item.description:
📝 TADA (Text-Acoustic Dual Alignment) resolves that mismatch with a novel tokenization schema that synchronizes text and speech one-to-one. A second of audio might be 2–3 text tokens but 12. Most existing systems address this by reducing audio frame rates or introducing intermediate "semantic" tokens between text and audio.
🔗 Read more: https://www.hume.ai/blog/opensource-tada
